reason: The raw evidence provides dates for Russell Terrier (19th century) but not for Basset Bleu de Gascogne. A bridge note linking Basset Bleu de Gascogne to Grand Bleu de Gascogne and a verification note for the origin of Grand Bleu de Gascogne would help determine which originated first.

derived_candidates.text: The Basset Bleu de Gascogne is descended from the Grand Bleu de Gascogne.
The Grand Bleu de Gascogne originated in France and is a scenthound type used for hunting in packs.
The Russell Terrier was derived from working terrier strains used in the 19th century for fox hunting.
